description: This header defines 128-bit integer types `uint128` and `int128`, including their constructors, operators, conversions, and related utilities. It provides a portable implementation with support for intrinsic `__int128` where available, and includes detailed class definitions, operator overloads, and numeric limits.

classes.name: uint128
classes.description: A portable 128-bit unsigned integer class supporting arithmetic, bitwise, and conversion operations, with optional intrinsic support.

classes.name: int128
classes.description: A portable 128-bit signed integer class supporting arithmetic, bitwise, and conversion operations, with optional intrinsic support.

methods.name: MakeUint128
methods.description: Constructs a `uint128` from two 64-bit unsigned integers.
